findings.title: Expired outer authentication becomes a generic fetch failure while WebSocket stays connected
findings.reproduction: On the actual 120 HTTPS deployment, leave the authenticated browser idle beyond Authelia inactivity=5m. Subsequent account/status fetch calls show Failed to fetch and retain the connected workspace. Reloading navigates to the authentication portal; after signing in the same draft is restored. A separate TLS-verified live request confirmed browser-default Accept */* yields 303 to the portal while application/json or X-Requested-With XMLHttpRequest yields 401.

findings.title: Terminal min-content width grows beyond the panel and produces unsupported native column counts
findings.reproduction: At a 1743px browser viewport, opening the terminal panel and allowing ResizeObserver fitting measured terminal-panel width 8811px, terminal-surface width 8767px and xterm-screen width 8737px within a 1499px workspace. The visible open terminal action returned Invalid cols; native RPC permits at most 500 columns. The button was outside the visible panel.
